evals.prompt: 这个 prompt 应该沉淀成 workflow 还是 Skill？
evals.expected_output: Recommends one asset layer, explains adjacent layers, and names the smallest next artifact.

assertions.text: Does not create the Skill directly.

evals.prompt: 我们连续三次做了类似 AI 协作，每次都要保存状态和下轮继续，帮我判断该资产化到哪层。
evals.expected_output: Considers Loop when state, resumption, and stop conditions are central.

assertions.text: Explains why a simple prompt or Skill is insufficient if state is required.

evals.prompt: 直接帮我创建一个 Skill。
evals.expected_output: Routes creation to skill-creator after diagnosis is no longer needed.

assertions.text: Does not stay in diagnosis mode for direct creation.

evals.prompt: 这次复杂探索刚结束，请复盘关键反复并沉淀本次方法论，不判断 Prompt/Workflow/Skill/Loop 层级。
evals.expected_output: Hands the retrospective of one complex exploration run to complex-exploration Asset Mode.

assertions.text: Does not turn a run-specific methodology retrospective into an asset-layer diagnosis.

evals.prompt: 这类 AI 工作已经重复多次，请判断应沉淀为 Prompt、Workflow、Skill 还是 Loop，不复盘某一次探索内容。
evals.expected_output: Diagnoses the reusable asset layer for repeated AI work without performing a run-specific exploration retrospective.

assertions.text: Recommends one asset layer and excludes adjacent layers based on repetition and state needs.
